notes.title: Regular Update 0.51
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


Hello Car Traders!

* Updated all UIs in Main Menu, Settings Menu.

* Added automatic game search to Main Menu > Multiplayer Menu.

* Updated language translations of in-game weekday names.

* Added Invert Mouse Y Axis.

Co-op:

* Updated the name of players above their heads in Co-op.

* In Co-op, you can open the in-game Chat screen by pressing the Enter button. You can chat with all players from the Chat screen.

Big update is coming!

In the next big update, you will be able to drive 8 luxury speed cars that cost more than $1M (of course, if you have the money to buy them :))

notes.title: Multiplayer Co-Op Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24/


Hello Car Trader!

Rent A Car Simulator 24's Multiplayer Co-Op gameplay has been updated.

Many bugs have been fixed for Co-Op gameplay.

Also, the following new features have been added.

New Co-Op Feature "Team"

"Team" menu added to in-game menu in multiplayer game.
From Team menu, you can see the players you play with and their Ping values.

New "Find Game" Screen

The Multiplayer Find Game section has been updated. Joining a Co-Op game is now much easier.

* In order to start a game specific to your own team, you need to enter a password when starting a new Multiplayer game. Of course, players you share the password with can log in to the game.



Thank you on behalf of Rent A Car Simulator 24!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/810a04cfda46bbb54029d4dec18bb102e0450c40.png

notes.title: Update 2: Long Term Car Rental
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099680/Rent_A_Car_Simulator_24


Hello Car Traders!

Now you can rent your cars for more than 1 day.

Go to the Licenses section on your office computer and buy the Long Term Rental license. And now the customers who come to your rental cars will make you offers for longer rentals.

* If you loaded the game with a save before the update, this license will be added to your game automatically. You will be able to rent for more than 1 day automatically. If you start a new game, you should buy this license :)

Next Update: Tuning for Drift Cars

We are preparing the Tuning Garage primarily to bring new styles to Drift cars. The next update will be next week. Get ready to give new styles to your Drift cars.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/d6f6bc697136040a00ee3c078f2b2a684287bdd1.png


Thank you on behalf of Rent A Car Simulator 24!

notes.title: Performance boost Hotfix for low-end systems
notes.notes:
Hello Car Traders

Rent A Car Simulator 24 can run properly with at least 4GB of graphics card memory.

This update also offers reasonable gameplay for players with 2GB of graphics card memory.

notes.title: Update 1: Are you ready for a new race car?
notes.notes:
Here is the first update released for Rent A Car Simulator 24

A new Race Car class car: Suparama Race Car

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/d73455613398633cd66987fd7e8121a20491a627.png

You can only get the new Suparama Race Car from the car auction and the chances are low. You may have to go to the auction a few days in a row to get it.

* The cars in the new Race Car category drive differently than daily cars and Drift Cars. Their acceleration is quite high.


Is anyone hungry?

Vendors are coming to the world of Rent A Car Simulator 24 for many of your needs. 

Perhaps one of your most important needs (!), the Hot Dog Vendor, is waiting for you right around the corner from your home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900158/fc7154b1cefd531fc2e7c8d744c7f66fd1440aeb.png

Bug Fixes

* Fixed issue where cars in high-rise offices would appear outside.

* Vehicle repair prices have been adjusted.

* Car spawn frequency has been adjusted. Cars now spawn more frequently.

* If you are stuck anywhere on the map, you can teleport to the office with Shift + Alt + T

This shortcut will be available as a button in the next update.
